title: 風はつぼみを揺らしたか

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, hi there, Zephyr. How's things?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hello, Zephyr. Are you off to eat lunch?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hello there. Yes, I'd like to bask in this nice sunlit breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I was thinking I'd eat as close to the sun as possible. I haven't yet decided where that will be, though…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Oh.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That sounds like a Brick-Wing's chirping… Hehe. Let's head over that way.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well then, may the breath of revelry be with you both.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …And there she goes. That one's as carefree as ever, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Looks like she had a packed lunch again today. Guess it's just as well I didn't invite her to come join us at the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Well, it's not like she's particularly cold. I'm sure she would have considered your offer if you'd asked.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: She really is a free-roaming wind, though—unbound by anyone or anything.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeahhh, she really is… But still.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's why I felt like it'd be worth asking if she wanted to come hang with us from time to time, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure what it is, but lately, I feel like her vibe's changed a teensy bit from how it was before.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hmm, maybe "changed" is the wrong word. It's more like she's changing, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I'm pretty sure it was shortly after I became Yamanin Zephyr's trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following a sudden downpour, we cut training short and ended up watching TV in my office…

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: …Next up, it's our "Catch a Rising Star" segment!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: We'll be taking a look at the most anticipated debuts coming up this year! Could the next turf hero be among them? Stay tuned!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh… Trainer, the sable squall outside has given way to some pale puffs.
choice_data_list: So… you mean it looks like the rain's let up?
So… you mean it looks like the rain's let up?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. I think I'll be able to run now. Let's get back to our training.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: First up, we have a racer whose powerful stride is expected to make a real impact in the mile tour…
choice_data_list: …Don't you want to watch the rest?
…Don't you want to watch the rest?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Why… would I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suspect they might highlight some tough opponents worth keeping an eye on, but before I get the chance to mention that…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: When I race, I'm going to become the true wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: However fiercely the derecho attempts to shred its surroundings…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I will become the strongest, and the fastest, and I will outrun all of the chaos.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …That is all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I felt it during her debut race—no, even back when we very first met, but… Yamanin Zephyr's particular brand of nonchalance is a cut above the rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's unshaken, unbound, and impervious to influence… She's the embodiment of a free wind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Well, at least she was.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: (Her eyes are glued to the TV…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try calling out to her several times, but receive no response whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may be a formless wind, but the TV has grabbed hold of her and won't let go. Right there, on the screen, is her fated opponent.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's Tokai Teio! Tokai Teio takes the lead! She's charging up the final hill, the Satsuki Sho in her sights!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio is leading the pack! There's that turn of foot we've heard so much about! …Aaand Tokai Teio finishes in first place!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio takes the win! It's Tokai Teio! The incredible and undefeated Monarch!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: And there you have it! I hope you all enjoyed those stunning highlights from the recent races!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio, once again, let me congratulate you on your fourth consecutive win since your debut!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: True to your word, you've made it to the Satsuki Sho—the first race of the Classic Triple Crown—without having suffered a single defeat!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: We'd love to hear what we can expect from you next!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You can expect me to win! Four consecutive victories isn't enough for me—I'm just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho, and become an undefeated Triple Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I knew it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr murmurs quietly as she gazes at the confidently grinning Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to have had something of a fixation on Tokai Teio—and her alone—for some time now, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ever since she told me they'd had a heart-to-heart, it's like the feelings she's harboring are growing more and more intense.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Undefeated Triple Crown champion… The title once earned by the Emperor.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (So you're chasing the winds of inspiration yourself, Teio. I thought you might be…)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: So, all that's left for you to do now is follow the path to becoming the Emperor of the new generation, is that right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh. Well…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mmm, not quite!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Oh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I've always looked up to Prez. That's why I want to become an undefeated Triple Crown champion, just like she did.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But that's not my goal! My dream's way further down the track.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be a Monarch who surpasses even the Emperor!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Someday, I'm gonna rise above the one who inspired me! I'll be the ultimate undefeated Monarch!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Rise above…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Rise above your inspiration…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A strong wind suddenly bursts in through the open window, carrying a single cherry blossom petal into the room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the New Zealand Trophy right around the corner, a wild spring is about to begin.
